Portfolio?
The single PDF document containing all the candidate's evidence of analysis, design, development, testing and evaluation.
Cross-reference?
A reference from one part of the portfolio to another, such as a test number or figure number, so evidence can be traced.
Traceability table?
A table linking each requirement to its design, development, test and evaluation evidence.
Referencing?
Acknowledging the sources used in a piece of work in a consistent format, so it is clear which work is the candidate's own.

Presentation does not replace content, but poor organisation can hide good work. Moderators look for clear, relevant evidence matched to the marking grid, so read the current grid and check every heading is covered. Remove padding such as long generic theory or repeated screenshots. Keep explanations concise and specific to your client. Proofread for spelling and technical accuracy, and check that the final PDF matches the version you intended to submit.
